channel.title: Alwin Joshy – Technical Art Blog
channel.description: Write-ups by Alwin Joshy, Technical Artist and Unity Engineer: shaders, scene lighting, performance optimisation and Unity tools.

item.title: Time of Day Lighting Study: One Cabin, Four Moods
item.description: One Unity URP cabin scene lit four ways: dawn, noon, dusk and night. How sun, sky ambient, bounce, reflections and support lights shape each mood.

item.title: A Voxel Light Baker for Streamed VR Scenes
item.description: How I baked lighting into tiny 3D textures for Calamity at Highstreet, so streamed VR scene blocks carry their own smooth lighting for a few hundred KB.

item.title: Cheap VR Grass for Highstreet
item.description: How I made cheap grass for Highstreet VR: an editor painter, one combined mesh, a proximity zone, alpha clip with 4x MSAA, and light from my voxel light baker.

item.title: A Crystal Shader for Highstreet's Growing Minerals
item.description: How I faked deep, glowing crystals for Highstreet in Unity Shader Graph: inset-edge meshes, parallax inner layers, sparkles, fake reflections and a growth dissolve.

item.title: Turning a Mesh into a Signed Distance Field in Unity
item.description: How I turned an ordinary palm tree mesh into a signed distance field in Unity and rendered it with ray marching, from brute force to three tiny 3D textures.

item.title: Giving AI a Face: Building Digital Humans at NPsynC
item.description: Why we built NPsynC, our company making AI staff with a face for government and enterprise, and how I create our digital humans in Unreal Engine.

item.title: How I Built the Three.js Hero Scene
item.description: How I built the three.js Spitfire hero scene on this site: Draco-compressed terrain, endless tiles, clouds in one draw call and fog that matches the sky.

item.title: AI Film Making
item.description: My first try at making an AI movie in 2024: ChatGPT for the prompts, a diffusion model for film-noir stills, then a video AI to bring each shot to life.

item.title: Custom Circular View Imposter
item.description: How I built custom imposters in Unity for Highstreet VR forests: a multi-angle capture tool, a texture atlas and a shader that blends views and keeps lighting.
